verdict.rationale: Render's own site states the story's capability directly: it keeps internal traffic off the public internet without VPC complexity [render-docs-10]. The ClickHouse guide shows the mechanism, running workloads as private services [render-docs-35], and environment isolation keeps non-production from reaching production services [render-docs-18]. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how private networking and service discovery work (e.g. internal hostnames, region scoping), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
